variants.description: Δ=0.0: XY model (Δ=0, no ZZ term)
variants.hypothesis: Heisenberg XXZ with Δ=0.0 at N=6 p=2: explore HVA expressibility. XY (Δ=0) expected to have highest fidelity; isotropic (Δ=1) lowest (~22%).

variants.description: TFIM baseline (same h-range for Heisenberg comparison)
variants.hypothesis: TFIM at same h-range as Heisenberg for direct comparison
variants.expected_outcome: PASS (ΔE/gap < 5%) — TFIM is easy at these h-values. Provides reference for quantifying Heisenberg difficulty.

variants.description: XY model (Δ=0) extended h-range (searching for valid regime)
variants.hypothesis: XY model with extended h-range may find a valid regime at high h. Δ=0 removes ZZ correlations → lower entanglement → better HVA fit.
variants.expected_outcome: Best chance of finding a valid regime among non-TFIM models. If XY fails, all XXZ models fail at p=2.
